settings.heading: New to reselling? Start here — not in the shop.
settings.body: You don't need experience, a business plan, or a big budget to begin. You need a starting point. This is it.

settings.heading: I've sold a little but I'm stuck
What Wholesale Actually Means
settings.body: Wholesale simply means buying stock in bulk, at a lower price per unit than you'd pay buying one at a time, so you can resell each item individually for a profit. GBG's minimum order quantities (MOQs) are kept low on purpose with most packs well under what a typical wholesaler asks for, this is so that you're not required to buy hundreds of units to get started.

settings.heading: Are You Ready? A Quick Checklist

settings.text: You have a small amount set aside to start with — even a single Starter Box.
You have (or are willing to set up) an account on at least one selling platform — Vinted, eBay, or TikTok Shop.
You can give this a few hours a week — listing, replying to buyers, restocking.
You're prepared for your first sale to take longer than your fifth.
